name: Shelly
description: European smart-home manufacturer known for compact Wi-Fi relays, plugs and energy-monitoring devices.

name: Snapmaker
description: Shenzhen-based maker of desktop 3D printers, laser engravers and CNC machines. The U1 is its four-toolhead printer.

name: DJI
description: Shenzhen-based drone and camera technology company founded in 2006, known for aerial systems, gimbals, action cameras and wireless microphones.

name: ArtCraft
description: Maker of the ArtCraft Suite: seventeen open-source creative apps built in Rust, covering image, vector, video, audio, motion, 3D, CAD and more.

name: SolidCraft
description: Open-source parametric CAD project by Tangency Labs, built in Rust. Desktop and browser apps share an editable feature history and an optional MCP server for AI agents.

name: Apple
description: Cupertino-based technology company behind the iPhone, Mac, iPad and a broad ecosystem of consumer hardware and software.

name: 3DJake
description: European 3D printing brand from niceshops in Austria, producing its own 3DJake filament line alongside printers, resin and accessories.
